text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco considers devolution for social and economic balance.
- Tangier appeal court cuts Briton David Richards jail term to four years from initial five-year sentence over drug charges.
- EU fish team visits Morocco to control ports sanitary conditions until Oct 31.
- Head of Central Bank Mohamed Seqat says liberalisation of interest rates is meant to reduce them through competition between banks.
- International building exhibition held in Casablanca shows that social housing prompted pickup of sector.
